FPIF is building toward a **31% long-term allocation to private markets**, split as follows:

| Asset class | Target allocation |
|---|---:|
| Private equity | 10% |
| Private debt | 7% |
| Real estate | 10% |
| Infrastructure | 4% |

Source: *FPIF February 2023 RFP*, Section 1.2, p. 1 (PDF p. 3).
